description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and attributes related to fault injection testing for transactional states within the Orleans framework. It includes attribute classes, factory interfaces and implementations, and mapping logic for dependency injection.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute used to mark parameters with fault injection transactional state configuration, holding state and storage names.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating fault injection transactional state instances based on configuration.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: Maps attribute data to dependency injection factories for transactional states.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a fault injection transactional state tailored to the given configuration and context.
